subject: [PATCH v2 6/6] NFSD: Document how to choose an IO mode

2026-10-29.patch_summary: This patch adds documentation to help administrators choose the correct IO mode for an NFS export, including when to use buffered, dontcache, or direct IO. It explains why a low server page cache hit rate is normal and lists workload conditions that favor each IO mode. The document also describes existing metrics to measure performance, such as per-export miss ratio and client mountstats byte counters.
